Political Science BA (pre-law track) at Yale University

What Yale University asks of applicants to Political Science BA (pre-law track) for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

US · All Yale University courses · Law field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 6 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • ACT or SAT required — all first-year and transfer applicants, from the 2026–27 cycle
  • Other exams, including international leaving exams and English proficiency exams, do not fulfil this requirement
Verified19 Oct 2026Yale: Standardized Testing · Yale: Application Update 2026–2027 · Yale: International Students
English language
  • English proficiency test required for non-native English speakers without two or more years of enrollment in an English-medium school
  • Tests listed:
    • TOEFL iBT, IELTS, Cambridge English (C1 Advanced, C2 Proficiency or B2 First), Duolingo English Test
    • InitialView interviews are also listed

Yale publishes the scores of its most competitive applicants, not minimum scores, so no score is shown as a requirement.

Verified19 Oct 2026Yale: Standardized Testing
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

Verified19 Oct 2026Yale: First-year requirements
Subject prerequisites
  • Not used in Altiora’s matching yet — see the note for the official guidance

Official: Yale has no required secondary-school courses, but advises taking courses each year in English, science, math, the social sciences and foreign language. This applies to all Yale College applicants, whatever the intended major.
